content.title: Coachella 2026 Weekend 2 live updates as Karol G brings out Peso Pluma
content.text: 10:35 pm PT April 19, 2026Who did Karol G bring out at Coachella?Niki KottmannKarol G started her Sunday Weekend 2 headlining set off strong with what proved to be the first of several special guests of the night: Peso Pluma.The crowd — many of whom had their phones ready as they heard the opening notes, just in case — went absolutely wild when the Mexican corridos tumbados artist came out to sing his collab with Karol, "QLONA," which got its live debut in Karol's native Medellín, Colombia in 2023.Later, she brought out fellow Coachella alum Becky G to sing their song "MAMIII," just like last weekend's set. The next two guests, however, were not the same as last weekend.J Balvin and Ryan Castro came out to sing several songs — including Bad Bunny collaboration "La Canción" — while Karol G did a costume change, and the crowd ate it up.9:41 pm PT April 19, 2026Young Thug brings out Mariah the Scientist, shows he has plenty of hitsTom CoulterA week after delivering a high-energy set at Coachella Weekend 1, Young Thug again reminded festivalgoers of his preeminence among 2010s rappers while bringing out Mariah the Scientist as a special guest for Weekend 2.The Coachella performances reflected a return to form for the rapper from Atlanta, who served more than two years behind bars due to racketeering and gang-related charges until his release from custody in late 2024. While sometimes performing over backing tracks, "Thugger" did plenty of rapping that showed off the wonky flows and vocal range that drove his rise to stardom.For Weekend 2, Young Thug changed some of his set list, performing older songs like “With That,” “Wyclef Jean” and “Family Don’t Matter,” though he still played his biggest hits, such as "Mamacita" and "Pick Up the Phone." (He also managed to perform “Best Friend,” after his set was cut short at the start of the song during Weekend 1.)About halfway through the set, Young Thug brought out Mariah the Scientist to perform her song, “Burning Blue.” Last weekend, Young Thug welcomed Camila Cabello, Ty Dolla $ign and Nav as surprise guests at various points during his set.After spending some of his set last weekend joking with celebrities like Teyana Taylor and North West, Young Thug continued the banter with people in the crowd. When he asked the crowd to form mosh pits, he bemoaned the VIP section's apparent indifference. (“Y’all on some bougie s---,” he said.) But he appreciated the non-VIP areas' enthusiasm, telling the crowd he loved them several times.9:00 pm PT April 19, 2026When is Karol G performing at Coachella?Niki KottmannThis weekend, Sunday headliner Karol G's set was moved slightly later. It will start at 10:10 p.m. PDT if all goes to plan.8:37 pm PT April 19, 2026A fun blast from Coachellas pastPaul Albani-BurgioOne of the most fun additions to this year's festival has been an installation from the clothing company Bella+Canvas called Coachella Merchandise: Past and Present. As the name suggests, the space is something of a retrospective of the evolution of Coachella merch, with T-shirts and posters from every year of the festival. There's also a fun wall display where attendees can place a pin on the year in which they first came to the festival. The installation can be found next to the main festival merch tent near the Ferris wheel. Not at the fest? Take a peek inside via our video.8:36 pm PT April 19, 2026The Strokes got political at Weekend 2, condemning U.S. foreign interventionTom CoulterThere were plenty of memorable outtakes from The Strokes’ Weekend 1 set at Coachella, with lead singer Julian Casablancas wearing an Amazon Prime-themed shirt with “Crime” in the place of the usual logo and joking about a U.S. military draft. But it was nowhere near as political as what fans saw at the end of their Weekend 2 set Saturday — and the internet is still talking about it a day later.During their closing song, “Oblivius” — which features the lyrics, “What side you standing on?” — the band displayed several videos denouncing alleged U.S. involvement in foreign governments. The video montage showed several leaders of foreign countries, including several Latin American countries, and accused the CIA of overthrowing their governments.It also showed Martin Luther King, Jr., and referenced a jury’s finding in a 1999 civil trial that MLK’s assassination was a conspiracy involving the federal government and other parties. In a subsequent investigation completed in 2000, the U.S. Department of Justice rejected the conspiracy allegations and declared no credible evidence of government involvement.The video closed by showing a pile of building rubble and stating that over 30 universities in Iran have been destroyed during the country’s war with the United States and Israel. It also showed the bombing of what was described as the last university in Gaza.Other bands have occasionally addressed political issues this year, usually expressing support for Palestine or condemning the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, but the video displayed by The Strokes was likely the most extensive statement of the weekend. The band had not issued any follow-up statements regarding the video as of Sunday afternoon.6:53 pm PT April 19, 2026Sonora is at capacity (aka don't try to see anyone there for a while)Niki KottmannCoachella app users got a push notification at 6:40 p.m. Sunday that the Sonora is at capacity, meaning they won't let anyone else in to listen to the current set, which is Mexican DJ/producer RØZ.That tracks, because our Desert Sun photographer was turned away to photograph the set before RØZ, Los Retros, and the line to get inside was incredibly long (see above). Today was the hottest day of Weekend 2, so it's possible several people were just seeking shade and air conditioning, or maybe these two artists are bigger than we realized — hard to say!We'll keep you posted on what else we learn about lines to get into different tents this evening.6:42 pm PT April 19, 2026Robert Trujillo of Metallica joins Suicidal TendenciesBrian BlueskyeSanta Monica-born bassist Robert Trujillo of the band Metallica surprised rock fans in the Mojave on Sunday afternoon when he came onstage as a special guest for heavy metal band Suicidal Tendencies to perform "Lovely" and "I Saw Your Mommy."6:20 pm PT April 19, 2026Gigi Perez brings out Hayley Kiyoko, sends a message to ICENiki KottmannGigi Perez had one of the best sets of Weekend 1, and Weekend 2 was no different — actually, it was even better.The singer-songwriter who rose to fame with her hit "Sailor" on TikTok got huge screams from the crowd when she brought out one of her musical idols, Hayley Kiyoko, to sing Kiyoko's Tumblr hit "Girls Like Girls" together, and ended the song by proudly waving the LGBTQIA rainbow flag together.In addition to sending a strong message of support for her fellow members of the queer community, toward the end of her set, Perez spoke about being Cuban-American and said it was a huge "privilege" to be on the Outdoor Theatre stage, especially as a daughter of immigrants. She also voiced her feelings about ICE, describing their recent actions as "atrocious."12:41 am PT April 19, 2026Billie Eilish joins Justin Bieber on stage for a hug not a song in Coachella throwback momentShad PowersIn a throwback to a famous 2019 moment when a starry-eyed young Billie Eilish couldn't believe she was meeting Justin Bieber when they ran into each other in the crowd at Coachella, the two met again at the Coachella Stage on Saturday night.At the same location of their first meeting just seven years later, Eilish came out of the crowd Saturday night, again seeming starstruck. The two shared a heartwarming embrace, laughing and smiling throughout and then Eilish slinked back into the crowd. She didn't perform, but it was a touching reunion.12:22 am PT April 19, 2026Justin Bieber brings out Sexyy Red in change-up from Weekend 1 performance at CoachellaShad PowersThe main elements to the first half of Justin Bieber's Weekend 2 headlining set Saturday was similar to the set he performed last Saturday, but one change featured rapper Sexyy Red who played her Coachella performance on Friday night at the Sahara Tent.Sexyy Red sang the Justin Bieber song "Sweet Spot" and then walked off Bieber's similarly minimalist set. During his Weekend 1 set, he had Kid Laroi come out at the spot, but Kid Laroi did not appear this Saturday.Will Bieber have more changes in store?12:15 am PT April 19, 2026Was Manon from KATSEYE on stage during the PinkPantheress Coachella set?Sam MorgenWas Manon, a member of the girl group KATSEYE who has been absent from their performances since February, on stage during another Coachella set?PinkPantheress performed with a slew of special guests, including Zara Larsson and Janelle Monae. Her performance also featured some famous names as background characters; "One Battle After Another" actress Chase Infiniti stood out as one.Some sharp-eyed X-users have pointed out that Manon appeared to be on stage as one of the extras. Manon was spotted at Coachella, so it is possible.11:44 pm PT April 18, 2026David Byrne starts on time, delivers a visually impressive setBrian BlueskyeFormer Talking Heads frontman David Byrne was able to start on time for his Weekend 2 set on Saturday on the Outdoor Theatre stage. During Weekend 1, he was about 30 minutes past his scheduled start time for his hour-long set.The production was impressive, especially when viewed on the video screens. The stage featured realistic scenes, including rooftops, store interiors, and natural landscapes. Even the floor was a video screen, detailed to match every scene. There were no amplifiers or monitors on stage. Instead, all the band members, including the keyboardist and percussionists, wore their instruments on shoulder harnesses over their chests. This allowed them to move and dance alongside Byrne.It was a stunning performance, but not as impressive as his "American Utopia" themed production when he performed on the same stage in 2018, which would be difficult to beat.10:22 pm PT April 18, 2026PinkPantheress celebrates early birthday with Zara Larsson, Janelle Monae, Tyriq Withers, Chase InfinitiEma SasicPinkPantheress got her birthday celebrations started early with an electric, guest-filled Weekend 2 that got everyone jumping around.Zara Larsson's highly anticipated appearance finally happened on Saturday, although not for their duet "Stateside." After the Swedish singer was nowhere to be found for PinkPantheress' opener, she later got her own moment to shine for her ear candy hit "Midnight Sun," where she appeared atop a platform and dancing on her own for thousands of fans.Later on, Blood Orange and Janelle Monae joined PinkPantheress on stage for "Pain" and "Another Life," respectively, accompanying her on instruments. Other people who appeared on stage during a club party scene included DJ Ninajirachi and "One Battle After Another" star Chase Infiniti.Actor Tyriq Withers returned as her "Romeo" once again this week, and he gave her a rose to ring in her birthday. The Brit turns 25 on Sunday.7:45 pm PT April 18, 2026Giveon brings out Teddy Swims, Snoop Dogg during Weekend 2 setEma SasicIf you're having a bit of déjà vu watching Giveon's set, there's a reason for it.Giveon welcomed Teddy Swims during his Saturday set, singing the latter's hit "Lose Control." Just a little over 24 hours ago, Teddy Swims was on that same stage singing the same song, as well as one of his collabs with Giveon called "Are You Even Real."But Giveon wasn't done. Shortly after Swims walked off, Snoop Dogg surprised the crowd as he sang "Beautiful." He's a repeat Coachella guest, as he came out during Weekend 1 with HUGEL.7:33 pm PT April 18, 2026Sombr continues rock tradition with Billy Idol as surprise guest for Weekend 2Ema SasicFor two weeks in a row, the Gen Z rocker Sombr brought out some royalty on the stage with him.On Saturday, April 18, he welcomed Billy Idol to perform his hit "Eyes Without a Face" with Steve Stevens on guitar.The previous week, Sombr was joined by Billy Corgan of The Smashing Pumpkins for their hit "1979."7:11 pm PT April 18, 2026A cancer diagnosis changed his life path, now he's DJing at Coachella. Meet Yousuke YukimatsuSam MorgenDJ Yousuke Yukimatsu took the stage in the Sahara tent Saturday night, capping off a remarkable run that began with one of the worst bits of news one can receive.In 2016, Yukimatsu was a construction worker who was diagnosed with a malignant brain tumor. After two surgeries, he decided to leave his job and devote all his energy to DJing.Last year, one of his frenetic sets caught attention online. Ever since then, Yukimatsu has been a rising star in the electronic music world. On Saturday, he combined classic rock hits by Bon Jovi with dance anthems by Daft Punk and Fred Again to toe-tapping effect.6:47 pm PT April 18, 2026Alex G brings his cryptic melodies to CoachellaTom CoulterThe steady rise of Alex G was on full display Saturday afternoon, as the Philadelphia-based artist and his band ran through their hits old and new at the Outdoor Theatre.Alex G gained recognition as an indie wonderkid in the early 2010s, after releasing music on Bandcamp at the age of 16, and the now 33-year-old treated the crowd to a few of those older songs, such as “Sarah” and “Forever.”While his experimental sound has evolved over the years, Alex G (full name Alex Giannascoli) still has a knack for hooks and cryptic lyrics that stick in your head. Backed by a three-piece band, Alex G performed several songs from his latest album and major-label debut, “Headlights,” and his 2022 album, “God Save the Animals.” He even came down from the stage and walked around in the crowd for his song, "Blessing," finding fans to sing along the lyrics with him.Alex G last played at Coachella in 2023 in the Sonora tent, and his jump to the Outdoor Theatre (paired with a midday set time) didn’t really translate to a large crowd. But those who attended were treated to many highlights, including Giannascoli busting out the accordion for “June Guitar.” 6:04 pm PT April 18, 2026Olivia Rodrigo jumps up with Addison Rae in surprise Weekend 2 appearanceShad PowersIn an afternoon surprise, Olivia Rodrigo joined Addison Rae to sing the song made famous by Rae "Headphones On" to the delight and stunned screams of the afternoon crowd.Rodrigo then stayed and sang her new song "Drop Dead." A song that just came out Friday.It was Rodrigo's first appearance on the Coachella Stage since joining No Doubt in a memorable guest spot in 2024.5:24 pm PT April 18, 2026Wagyu beef and caviar dreams. There's a $250 cheeseburger at CoachellaBrian BlueskyeWe have come across the most expensive food we've seen over the past two weekends during the festival, and surprisingly, it's not in the VIP area. A stand near the Mojave and Gobi tent areas, operated by a company called Butterypat, is selling wagyu cheesesteak sandwiches. One sandwich on the menu, in particular, caught my eye and made me do a double-take.If you have $250 to spend, you can purchase the sandwich of your dreams, which features wagyu beef, cheddar cheese, truffle butter, and caviar. Additionally, it comes with exclusive merchandise — a Butterypat track jacket, as advertised on Instagram.But it’s ok, you can enjoy the regular $25 version of the sandwich if you’re budget-conscious, or a $24 vegan version.4:15 pm PT April 18, 2026Kacey Musgraves rides into Coachella on a horse for her Saturday setSam MorgenKacey Musgraves certainly knows how to make an entrance. She began her Saturday set by riding into the Mojave tent on a horse.The performance started with a live feed of the back of the stage. Musgraves came into view on top of a horse as the crowd cheered. It soon became apparent that Musgraves would ride into the tent itself while on the horse.She could be seen on the left side of the stage atop the animal. She dismounted and walked up to sing her newly-released single "Middle of Nowhere."3:10 pm PT April 18, 2026Day 2 of weekend 2 begins as fans still buzzing about Madonna, Lisa guest appearancesShad PowersEvery once in a while good fortune smiles on Weekend 2 festivalgoers and Friday night was a prime example.Weekend 1 attendees probably felt a little jealous as it was their turn to watch the livestream and see Madonna perform with Sabrina Carpenter and Lisa from BLACKPINK jumped up with Anyma.Madonna, Lisa highlight Coachella Weekend 2 guest stars so farCarpenter did not have any musical special guests during the first week, and Anyma wasn't even able to put on his show, much less have a special guest, due to a wind-blown cancellation.Will the Weekend 2 hot streak continue Saturday? Justin Bieber, Kacey Musgraves, The Strokes and PinkPantheress all perform.1:22 am PT April 18, 2026Blood Orange deploys unique stage, brings out Turnstile's Brendan YatesTom CoulterCoachella has seen just about every stage gimmick you can imagine, so it’s rare when you find something that feels like a unique setup. Yet that’s exactly what Blood Orange pulled off with his midnight show at the Mojave tent, and he brought out Turnstile lead singer Brendan Yates to boot.The English musician, who offers a grooving mix of R&B, rock and jazz, performed on a stage built in the middle of the tent, giving his bandmates more of the spotlight than at a typical stage. With drums, saxophone, harmonica, violin and even a bit of tambourine, the band was in steady lockstep with Blood Orange, who played cello, keyboard and guitar throughout the set.After opening with a cello-laden cover of The Smiths’ “How Soon is Now?" Blood Orange played some songs from his latest album, “Essex Honey,” and Yates briefly joined him to perform “ALIEN LOVE CALL,” just hours after finishing his own show at the Outdoor Theatre. Blood Orange also played some of his earlier hits, including “Best to You," "Charcoal Baby” and the closer, “Champagne Coast," which drew the loudest cheers from the crowd surrounding the stage.While others were partying away the night to Anyma or Sexyy Red, Blood Orange offered a more low-key way to close the night, and other artists should take note of his unique stage and consider similar setups in the festival’s future. 1:09 am PT April 18, 2026Swae Lee joins Anyma for Coachella Friday night setDaniel SimonItalian-American music producer and DJ Anyma is having a better Weekend 2 than he did Weekend 1 after being unable to perform his ÆDEN show due to high winds and concerns for the audience's safety. With dazzling visuals, heart-pumping techno-trance beats and dark, but uplifting atmosphere, Anyma came back with a vengeance. Rap star and Inglewood, California's own Swae Lee (and half of Rae Sremmund, a rap group with his brother that rose to prominence with hits like "Black Beatles" and "No Flex Zone") also made an appearance as well after his performance earlier in the day. His serenades and calm, but confident charisma took the crowd to a familiar era of serenading sounds and trance-like rhythms from the rap industry.Anyma ended his set at 1:09 a.m. Saturday, meaning he went 9 minutes over curfew, so Goldenvoice will be fined.1:06 am PT April 18, 2026Lisa of Blackpink comes out as a special guest for AnymaNiki KottmannAnyma, the solo EDM project of Italian-American Matteo Milleri, brought out beloved Blackpink member Lisa to perform their new collaboration "Bad Angel" live for the first time during his Friday closing set.Lisa came out looking, well, angelic, in a white wig and white and silver futuristic dress, and she sang while strutting the catwalk, resulting in many screams from the lucky fans who got to see her up close.10:28 pm PT April 17, 2026Madonna performs 'Vogue,' 'Like a Prayer' with Sabrina CarpenterNiki KottmannThe rumors were true.Like a "Ray of Light," one of pop music's biggest stars popped up as a surprise guest for Coachella headliner Sabrina Carpenter during her Friday, April 17 set. Madonna came out to some, but not enough, cheers from the crowd — many of whom were born long after her biggest hits were on the radio.Many social media users pushed the rumor forward in the days leading up to Carpenter's Weekend 2 performance, with the resounding consensus being that it would just make sense — Carpenter loves to pay homage to the pop songstresses that came before her, and this month marks the 20th anniversary of the last and only time Madonna has ever been on the Coachella lineup: April 30, 2006.The pair sang "Vogue," followed by what appears to be a new song off Madonna's upcoming album, "Confessions II," followed by "Like a Prayer," before Madonna gave a lengthy speech thanking Carpenter.The pair hugged, and then the queen of pop was gone as quickly as she appeared.9:52 pm PT April 17, 2026Terry Crews, Geena Davis join Sabrina Carpenter for Weekend 2Shad PowersIn a full-circle moment for fans of 1990s cinema, instead of Susan Sarandon doing a spoken word interlude during the Sabrina Carpenter set at Coachella, it was Sarandon's "Thelma and Louise" partner Geena Davis behind the wheel on Weekend 2.Davis' soliloquy was about half as long as Sarandon's. Then Carpenter launched into "Go Go Juice" just as she did after Sarandon during Week 1.And instead of Will Ferrell playing Mr. Fix-it with the electricity like in Weekend 1, this time it was Terry Crews of "Brooklyn 99" and "America's Got Talent" fame. He did a similar schtick, plugging the electricity back in and turning the lights back in, though he took some time to flex his muscles topless, a move Ferrell did not do.9:31 pm PT April 17, 2026KATSEYE not golden, but still 'gnarly'Sam MorgenKATSEYE took the stage once again on Friday for Weekend 2 of Coachella. The band was still missing its sixth original member, Manon, and it skipped one of the most electrifying moments of its Weekend 1 performance.Still, the supergroup wowed with its perfect choreography and excellent vocals.The band took the opportunity to remind the audience of its upcoming EP, "Wild," which comes out on Aug. 14.Most people in the crowd could have gone without the announcement if it took the place of a cameo from the "KPop Demon Hunters" singers for a rendition of "Golden."In lieu of "Golden," KATSEYE performed "Tonight I Might," a song that was not on the Weekend 1 setlist. Some in the crowd were disappointed, but most left singing the songs they'd just heard.8:41 pm PT April 17, 2026Dijon leads intimate jam session week after joining Justin Bieber on stageTom CoulterSome people tuning into Justin Bieber’s Weekend 1 headlining set may not have known Dijon, the talented singer and producer who joined Bieber on stage last weekend to perform their song, “DEVOTION.” But word is getting out about Dijon, who helped with production on several songs from Bieber’s album “SWAG,” and he offered a noisy yet intimate performance at the Outdoor Theatre that should only further propel his popularity.His organic jam session with seven other musicians reflected his unique mix of R&B, soul, jazz and indie music, with the band finding grooves at seemingly every turn. The group opened with “Many Times” from his 2021 album, “Absolutely.”Dijon (full name Dijon Duenas) often acted as conductor for his band, playing guitar for several songs and leading a duet that gave two other singers a chance to shine. He led his band in a speedier version of “Baby!,” the lead track to his 2025 album of the same name, and they played "Rewind” in three different keys, as he noted for the crowd. (This time, he appeared without guitarist Mk.gee, who also joined Bieber on stage last weekend to play guitar for the closing song, "DAISIES.")For his last song, “Rodeo Clown,” Dijon came down from the stage and played his guitar along the barricade, eventually singing to what appeared to be his wife and child. While a slower experience than most Coachella acts, the grooving band session still offered a performance that we hope will keep propelling Dijon’s rise.8:08 pm PT April 17, 2026We went in search of a Coachella speakeasy. Here's what we found.Paul Albani-BurgioOne of the recent staples at Coachella have been the "secret" speakeasies that can be found sprinkled around the festival grounds. After hearing all about them during Weekend 1, we decided to attempt to check out the fun four ourselves during Weekend 2. We first attempted to go to the Sabrina Carpenter-themed speakeasy that can be entered from the inside of the Indio Central Market.But when crowds kept us out of that one (you can read more about that downblog), we headed instead to the Neon Cactus speakeasy near the Craft Beer Barn. There, we found a vibey place to cool off, dance and order a boozey concoction that came in a Coachella souvenir cup.6:55 pm PT April 17, 2026Central Cee brings UK rap to CoachellaSam MorgenCentral Cee thrilled the audience at Coachella ... part of the time. The British rapper performed an array of songs during his roughly 45-minute, but only three or four got the crowd excited.For the most part, people stood around, bobbing their heads, or not even moving at all. One woman standing next to me conducted a 10-minute phone call, which seemed impossible in the loud environment.For much of his performance, Central Cee had to be content with bobbing along to the music, himself. He played several songs containing lengthy features. He brought out no special guests, so the recording of the featured rappers played while Central Cee walked up and down the stage.It's a common tactic used during rap songs, but it didn't work well when so many of those half-performances were lined up one after the other.The set may have been more memorable for the£400,000 necklace of Queen Elizabeth worn by the rapper both weekends. The former queen would have been 100 years old this year and her side profile was prominently displayed on Central Cee's neck.The diamond-encrusted necklace swung around, attracting my attention as I wondered how much it was worth. A quick Google search following the set answered my question.Queen Elizabeth died in 2022, but she's still making British citizens proud.6:46 pm PT April 17, 2026Joyce Manor mixes nolstalgia, new bangersPaul Albani-BurgioSometimes it’s nice to go back to the early 2010s.On Friday, pop punk band Joyce Manor’s evening Coachella set successfully transported us back to that fabled era of Obama, Twilight and Angry Birds.The crowd, unsurprisingly, came to life for the band’s early 2010s favorites “Heart Tattoo,” “Catalina Fight Song,” and, especially, “Constant Headache,” with the many joining in belting out the latter’s lyrics.But the band also showed they are doing OK in 2026 as well, playing multiple songs from their most recent album, last year’s “I Used To Go To This Bar.” The song “I Know Where Mark Chen Lived,” which opened the show, felt like the kind of classic pop punk banger I played over and over again growing up (so much so that I had to doublecheck what year it was from).6:38 pm PT April 17, 2026Lykke Li's afternoon set would have looked cooler at nightBrian BlueskyeSwedish Indie-pop singer-songwriter Lykke Li delivered a fantastic performance at the Outdoor Theatre. Visually, her set made a strong artistic statement, but it also screamed, “Imagine how cool this would look at night!”The stage production featured construction scaffolding covered in plastic, with purple fluorescent lights placed along the rails. Additionally, she performed on a large plexiglass platform, and views from above were displayed on a video wall that also featured plastic and purple lights embedded in the floor.She braved the afternoon sun wearing a black hooded jacket, which matched her band members, who wore black hoodies during the entire set. She later came out in a gray hooded cloak and told the crowd, “I only love you if you scream,” and also said before starting the second half of her 50-minute set, “If you have any weed, I’d smoke it now.”At the end of her performance, she lit a cigarette and danced off stage as Corona’s “The Rhythm of the Night” blasted over the stage speakers, and was shown on the video wall continuing to dance backstage.6:05 pm PT April 17, 2026David Lee Roth returns for Weekend 2 to join Teddy Swims on stageShad PowersTeddy Swims excited the crowd during Weekend 1 with three well-known special guests. Well, he treated Weekend 2 to 33% of that same excitement.Those three guests from last week were Joe Jonas, Vanessa Carlton and David Lee Roth.Only David Lee Roth returned for Weekend 2, playing the iconic Van Halen song "Jump." It was a fun moment, but fans may have expected a different parade of stars to ring Swims' magic doorbell and join him on stage after Week 1's guest fireworks.And Teddy Swims isn't even done. He's also doing the desert threepeat, by performing at Stagecoach next weekend on Saturday. We'll see who, if anyone, he brings out. Who knows? Maybe David Lee Roth will throw a cowboy hat on and be there again.Swims still delivered another well-received set, finishing with his haunting and powerful song "Lose Control."5:28 pm PT April 17, 2026Wednesday brings early energy to the Sonora tentTom CoulterWednesday showed off its wide-ranging talent during a Friday set in the Sonora tent, incorporating everything from steel guitar to full-throated screams. The Asheville-based band, which has drawn critical acclaim for its recent albums, including 2025’s “Bleeds,” was a perfect afternoon act for people looking to blow off some steam early in the festival.Lead singer Karly Hartzman showed off her dynamic vocals that sometimes have a country twang (particularly on standout track “Elderberry Wine”) yet easily twist into lung-busting screams. Hartzman welcomed a mosh pit in the middle of the crowd about halfway through the show, and dozens of people bounced around in delight as the band ripped through several more songs.Hartzman also got political before the song “Bull Believer,” inviting the crowd to scream along in response to “the darkest time in our country’s history in a really long time,” referring to recent immigration actions by federal agents. (“F— ICE,” Hartzman added.)The band played at least one song, “Townies,” that they didn’t perform during Weekend 1, and the crowd was delighted by its guitar-shredding chorus. Wednesday on a Friday proved to be a strong way to spend an afternoon in the air-conditioned indoor tent. 4:50 pm PT April 17, 2026Wait to enter Sabrina Carpenter speakeasy reaches 90 minutesPaul Albani-BurgioOne of the most popular places to be during the early afternoon of Weekend 2, Day 1 was the Sabrina Carpenter-themed speakeasy, which can be entered from within the Indio Central Market.While the entrance to the speakeasy is meant to be marked by a conspicuous old-timey looking elevator sign, there was no missing it Friday thanks to the lengthy line snaking around the front. A line attendant told us at about 3:10 p.m. that the estimated wait was currently an hour-and-a-half and that no one else would be allowed to get in line until several more people were let in.4:43 pm PT April 17, 2026Aerial message appears at Coachella related to d4vd arrestEma SasicEditor's note: While the source of this message has still not been confirmed, The Desert Sun has learned it could be related to the marketing of the new Netflix movie "Roommates."A surprising aerial message appeared above the Coachella grounds around 4 p.m. Friday, seemingly connected to singer (and Coachella alum) D4vd's arrest in the 2025 killing of teenager Celeste Rivas Hernandez in Hollywood.The words "Celeste is a liar" appeared multiple times in the sky, prompting festivalgoers to look up and question the message. As some suggested that it was connected to the case, people were heard saying "That is crazy."Singer D4vd, whose name is David Anthony Burke, was arrested on suspicion of murder on Thursday, April 16, months after police said the body of Hernandez was found in a vehicle belonging to him. He is being held without bail, the Los Angeles Police Department confirmed.4:40 pm PT April 17, 2026Slayyyter draws a huge crowd to kick off Weekend 2Sam MorgenAs the first act up with some name recognition, hyperpop singer Slayyyter was bound to draw a large crowd to the early Friday afternoon. But her crowd on Weekend 2 was big even by those standards. People overflowed the Mojave tent as she started singing, and more people kept showing up after that.The Missouri singer rose to popularity in the late 2010s, releasing viral hits that allowed her to open for Charli xcx in 2019.She brought the same raucous energy on Friday. It was clear she'd learned something from Charli xcx about stage presence.Her well-attended Weekend 1 set gained attention online, perhaps drawing some curious onlookers Weekend 2. While the crowd sang and danced in the middle of the tent, the same cannot be said for those on the outside.Where I stood, people mostly bobbed their heads appreciatively, or stared at the screens for most of the concert.
